units: <cite ref="Pesachim 11a:2">Pes. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>טחינה וה׳ מא״ל</he> in grinding and sifting (the flour) what change from the ordinary process can he make? <cite ref="Pesachim 11a:2">Ib.</cite> <he>ה׳ ע״ג נפה</he> he does the sifting on the back of the sieve.
